newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota to buy engine parts from Dana - paper.
newsitem.headline: Toyota to buy engine parts from Dana - paper.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp will procure engine parts from U.S. vehicle components maker Dana Corp starting this month, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported.
Toyota will use cylinder liners made by Dana in cars produced at its U.S. unit, Toyota Motor Manufacturing Kentucky Inc, the paper reported at the weekend.
It will be the first time a Japanese automaker has procured a main engine component from a foreign firm and will help Toyota significantly reduce manufacturing costs, the paper said.
A company spokesman was not immediately available on Monday morning to comment on the report.
